phrases.english: Are we there yet? — Not yet. (The boy never asks it.)

phrases.latin: Quandō rūrsus volābimus? — Mox. Nōndum dīmidium itineris cōnfēcimus.
phrases.english: When will we fly again? — Soon. We haven’t done half the journey yet.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 350.
